units.raw_text: Ran the multimedia reference design program across three flagship SoC generations (Halberd 8200, 8300, 8400). Owned the codec, ISP, and display feature matrix that OEMs took as their starting point, including AV1 decode rollout across the 8300 cycle and 8K30 HDR10+ recording on the 8400.
units.normalized_summary: Ran multimedia reference design program across three flagship SoC generations (Halberd 8200, 8300, 8400) — owned codec, ISP, and display feature matrix including AV1 decode rollout and 8K30 HDR10+ recording

item.text: As Director of Multimedia at Halberd, ran the multimedia reference design program across three flagship SoC generations, including the AV1 decode rollout.
